item.description: After almost forty years of service a Co Cavan postwoman has delivered her final letters. item.title: Ras Tailteann is all systems go
item.description: The route for the Ras Tailteann 2026 has been released and will see this years event focusing in the South West of the country. Starting on the 20th of May from Portlaoise the race will head towards Limerick, Kerry and Cork over the opening days before coming back via Wexford, Wicklow, Carlow, Kildare and finishing in Dunboyne in Co Meath on the 24th. Cyclists will compete over 5 stages covering 785 kilometers that will include 21 categorised climbs. Advertisement

item.title: "Please come forward to end this most unimaginable suffering" - James Nesbitt
item.description: Actor James Nesbitt has appealed for any information that can help the plight of the Families of the disappeared. His appeal on Northern Sound today follows his emotional and impassioned plea on behalf of the families of the disappeared on the Late Late Show. While he will be well known for his many television drama roles, his work behind the scenes supporting victims and survivors of the Troubles as a long time Patron of the WAVE Trauma Centre is a lesser known but important facet of his life.

item.title: Local senator highlights need for stronger Irish Defence Forces
item.description: A local senator is warning that rising global instability highlights a need for stronger Irish Defence Forces, despite remaining militarily neutral. Senator Joe O'Reilly cited a number of conflicts in Ukraine, Sudan and Myanmar, as well as tensions in Eastern Europe and the Middle East, as evidence of an increasingly uncertain world. item.title: Cash taken in break-in to Ballyconnell home this week
item.description: An investigation has been launched following a break in to a house in Ballyconnell. Gardaí say they received a report of a burglary at a house in Ballyconnell which occurred sometime between 6:00pm Tuesday night and 7am Wednesday. During the course of the break in cash was taken. Gardai say investigations are currently ongoing. Advertisement

item.title: Ireland set to face Isreal in Nations League
item.description: The FAI say they will fulfil their Nations League fixtures with Isreal set for later this year. The Republic of Ireland have been drawn face Isreal in League B of the Nations League. Heimir Hallgrimsson's team will also face Austria and Kosvo in league B group three. In November, the FAI voted to submit a motion to UEFA to ban Israel from European club and international competitions.
